title: Ecosystem workflow discovery manifest (#3284)
description: Aggregates every tier-1 repo's docs/registry/workflows.yaml into a single provenance-stamped manifest. The per-workflow field-set is exactly what the reference resolver deckhand/src/deckhand/capability_smoke.py consumes, so a consumer can round-trip an entry through resolve_workflow().

manifest_version.description: Manifest-format version, independent of per-repo registry schema_version.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC generation timestamp. EXCLUDED from --check stale comparison.

resolver.description: The reference resolver whose consumed field-set this manifest targets (D1).

schema_version.description: Per-repo declared registry schema_version, recorded not assumed (target = v2 additive superset, D1).

registry_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw registry text. Null for non-ok repos. The --check stale gate compares only this set.

workflow_id.description: repo:id@version (D4) — disambiguates duplicate ids across versions.

routing_id.description: repo:id — unversioned routing key; resolve via latest_by_routing_id.

input.description: Per-row input PRESERVED (D4) — the resolver fails closed without it.

invocation.description: TOP-LEVEL registry invocation template, {input}-only substitution (D1). NEVER falls back to a per-row test nodeid. Null + warning for pre-#3295 registries.

license_gated.description: Derives from runtime == 'requires-license' (D4). data_source.network_required does NOT set this.

request_schema.description: Structured descriptor passthrough (D1) — null when absent, NO str coercion. #3295 reserves the slot, #3282 owns the shape.

response_schema.description: Structured descriptor passthrough (D1) — null when absent, NO str coercion.

result.description: Registry 'result:' location descriptor (owned by #3282) — null until populated.

data_source.description: Informational network/fixture passthrough — NOT the license gate.

determinism.description: Reserved-null passthrough (D3/D6) — #3283 (Wave 2) populates via key-allowlist, NOT a registry heuristic.

latest_by_routing_id.description: routing_id -> resolved workflow_id when unpinned: latest-stable (latest:true stable row if flagged, else highest stable version, else highest of any status). Mirrors capability_smoke._select_version (D4).
